about_the_game:
Everything in this world is made for a happy life. You want to go to the arcades or relax at the cottage, it's all possible here. To choose what to do, you just need to find the right place, and that's it. By the way, if you want, you can even become an elf. It's the norm here.

It would be boring to be alone, so you're sure to find new friends or even a soulmate here. Will you be able to open up to each other? It doesn't matter, because either way, it's more fun together.

Non-linear world

Try just walking around, maybe you'll find something interesting around the next corner. There are plenty of interesting places waiting to be discovered. Although, you can always just go with the flow, and even so, discover something new.

Additional modes

  • Rhythm Games

  • Gathering

  • Crafting

  • And more!

Unexpected encounters

See an old acquaintance? Perhaps it's a fateful encounter! Don't miss the opportunity to find familiar characters and references that were clearly inspired by the creator of this world.
